NOTICE UNDER SECTION 7 OF THE LAND
ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) ASAMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section 7 of the LandAcquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition(Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Governmentintends to acquire the following land/servitude which isrequired for a public purpose :-
Description of the land or servitude to be acquired:

Allotments of land called in extent 3.3712 of Hectares,0.0166 of Hectare, 0.0632 of Hectare shown as lot 1379,1896, 1897 in FVP .27, FVP. 29 dated 10.08.2018 preparedby the Surveyor General. Situated in with in the PradeshiyaSabha limits of Trincomalee No. 243, Uppuveli GramaNiladhari Division, Divisional Secretariat Division of Town& Gravets, Trincomalee District and bounded as follows.Details Attached.

Lot No. 1379North Lot: Lot 2; East Lots: Lots 104, 1898 and FVP 29;South Lots: Lot 2, Lots 104, 1898, 1897, 102, Lot 2, Lots1896 and 102 in FVP 29; West Lots: Lot 2, Road(RoadDevelopment Authority) and Lot 2; Extent: 3.3712 Hectares.
Lot No. 1896North Lot: Lot 1378, 2 in FVP 27 and Lot 102; East Lot:Lot 102; South Lot: Lot 102; West Lots: Lot 102, Lots 2 and1378 in FVP 27; Extent: 0.0166 Hectare.
Lot No. 1897North Lots: Lots 1378, FVP 27 and Lot 1898; East Lots: Lots1898, 1899 and Lot 102; South Lots: Lot 102; West Lots: Lots2 and 1378 in FVP 27; Extent: 0.0632 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on whicha servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appearpersonally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before meat Divisional secretariat Trincomalee on the 29th day ofOctober 2018 at 10.00 a.m. and you are hereby requested tonotify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 08th dayof October 2018, the nature of their interests in the land, theparticulars of their claims for compensation and the details ofthe computation of such amount.
All deeds and documents in support of the claims shouldbe produced before me at the inquiry.
J.S. ARULRAJ,Divisional Secretary,District-Trincomalee.
26th September, 2018.
